headline: Approved a new civilian Parking Enforcement position and a pay plan change under the new Teamsters Local 251 contract.
summary: Police Captain Joseph Skahan presented a new civilian Parking Enforcement position. The role will enforce parking violations, with a focus on the stadium and downtown areas. Teamsters Local 251 and the City Water Supply Board agreed to a new contract with increases of 3.25% in year 1, 3.25% in year 2, and 3.5% in year 3.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 11, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Approved the new Parking Enforcement civilian position, 4-0.
Approved the change to the pay plan for Water Supply Board and Teamsters Local 251 under the new contract, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve August 11, 2026 minutes made by Joe Shottek, 2nd by Will Ruggiero. Approved 4-0.
Motion to approve Parking Enforcement position made by Will Ruggiero, 2nd by Joe Shottek. Approved 4-0.
Motion to approve request to change pay plan for Water Supply Board/Teamsters Local 251 made by Will Ruggiero, 2nd by Joseph Shottek. Approved 3-0.

decision_titles: New Teamsters Local 251 contract pay plan
